## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check src tests benchmarks`
- [ ] Tests added for changes to numerical behavior
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when appropriate
- [ ] All underlying methods and citations correctly attributed
- [ ] No copyrighted papers, credentials, or restricted datasets committed

## Scientific reproducibility

Document seeds, numeric tolerances, and reference baselines for any
algorithmic or benchmarking change.
